note.title: Free-time activities
note.specFocus: hobbies, music, sport, entertainment and leisure preferences
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
2.1 Free-time activities
Key focus
- hobbies, music, sport, entertainment and leisure preferences.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use verbs of liking, frequency adverbs and justified opinions; narrate past events in a clear sequence.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: In my free time I play the guitar in a small band.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Nel tempo libero suono la chitarra in un piccolo gruppo.”

What instrument does the speaker play, and in what group?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: On Saturdays I play volleyball at the sports centre with my friends.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Il sabato gioco a pallavolo al centro sportivo con le mie amiche.”

What, where and with whom does the speaker play on Saturdays?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I prefer funny films because they make me forget about school.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Preferisco i film divertenti perché mi fanno dimenticare la scuola.”

Which films are preferred, and why?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: Last Saturday we saw a concert, but the tickets were expensive.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Sabato scorso abbiamo visto un concerto, ma i biglietti erano cari.”

What happened last Saturday, and what was the drawback?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: I hardly ever watch television during the week.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Non guardo quasi mai la televisione durante la settimana.”

How often does the speaker watch television on weekdays?

questions.examTip: Read the complete sentence before answering; check time phrases, negatives and the relationship between the main words.
questions.modelAnswer: This summer I will learn to surf and go to the sea every morning.
questions.question:
Reading comprehension. Read the Italian sentence and answer in English:

“Quest’estate imparerò a fare surf e visiterò il mare ogni mattina.”

What will the speaker learn, and how often will they visit the sea?
